learning_outcomes.text: On the basis of a deep knowledge of kinematics, statics and dynamics of mechanical systems, the course provides the practical and theoretical knowledge required for a proper functional design of machines and their devices.

syllabus_topics: Degrees of freedom, Gruebler and Kutzbach formulas
Cases of friction in prismatic pairs, revolute pairs, thrust bearings, inclined planes, screw and nut
Cases of idler wheels, driving wheels, driven wheels
Efficiency, machines in series and parallel, retrograde motion
Newtonian fluids, conservation of mass, constitutive laws, viscosity and units of measurement
Reynolds equation in 2D and 3D, notes on elastohydrodynamics
Hydrodynamic lubrication: applications—fixed and tilting pad bearings, axial and radial bearings, bushings, Sommerfeld number
Hydrostatic lubrication: cases of radial and axial pairs
Galileo’s theorem, instantaneous center of rotation
Euler–Savary theorem, conjugate profiles, circle of inflection points, Rivals theorem, applications
Analysis and synthesis of four-bar and six-bar linkages, crank mechanisms
Notes on other joints (Birfield, tripod, Rzeppa)
Friction wheels and motivation for gears
Cylindrical involute gears: definitions, properties, corrections
Helical gears, bevel gears, Tredgold’s method, worm–helical gear pair
Willis formula, combinatorial gear trains, differentials, automotive gearboxes
Pulleys, hoists, belt drives, band brakes
Systems with constraints and equations of motion
Equivalent masses, balancing of engines with 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 cylinders
Numerical methods for integration of motion equations
Torque curves, longitudinal dynamics of the vehicle
bibliography: E. FUNAIOLI, A.MAGGIORE, U.MENEGHETTI: “Lezioni di Meccanica Applicata alle Macchine”, Voll.1-2, Patron Editore, Bologna.
For the activities: notes written by the teacher.
Other books might be suggested during the lessons.
